Name: that one tile in the slime hutch that you cant place stuff on FIX
Author: LeviEragorr
Description:
oh you dont own a slime hutch? pleb...

lets say you finally bought a slime hutch (congrats!), after watching some yt tutorials you found out that you can limit the spawn area of slime eggs using floorings. then arises a teeny tiny problem. WHY THE HELL CANT I PLACE FLOORING ON THE TILE BELOW THE BUILT-IN SLIME INCUBATOR?!

yeah fixed and done. youre welcome.
